channel.title: Agenda
channel.description: “Agenda” is a sharp, no-nonsense news podcast that breaks down the stories shaping our world.Each episode delivers clear, concise insights into the day’s biggest headlines — without the noise, hype, or spin.We explain what’s happening, why it matters, and how it fits into the bigger picture.Fast. Focused. Insightful.Whether you want a quick briefing or deeper context, “Agenda” keeps you informed and ahead of the curve.
channel.itunes:author: Agenda

item.title: Episode 4: Litigation Risks, IP Conflicts, and Global Security Threats
item.itunes:title: Episode 4: Litigation Risks, IP Conflicts, and Global Security Threats
item.description: The final episode synthesizes the emerging legal risks—covering civil liability and intellectual property—and concludes with an analysis of how US technology is being leveraged by adversarial states for geopolitical and security purposes.

item.title: Episode 3: The EU AI Act: Extraterritoriality and Direct US Compliance Costs
item.itunes:title: Episode 3: The EU AI Act: Extraterritoriality and Direct US Compliance Costs
item.description: This episode dissects the operational mechanics of the EU AI Act, focusing entirely on how its risk classification and supply chain obligations impose unavoidable compliance costs on U.S. companies aiming to serve the European Single Market.

item.title: Episode 2: The General-Purpose AI (GPAI) Battleground and Innovation Conflict
item.itunes:title: Episode 2: The General-Purpose AI (GPAI) Battleground and Innovation Conflict
item.description: This episode focuses on the highly contested regulatory territory of large foundation models, primarily developed by U.S. technology leaders, examining the unique obligations, compliance challenges, and industry resistance.

item.title: Episode 1: The U.S. Domestic AI Regulatory War and Federal Preemption
item.itunes:title: Episode 1: The U.S. Domestic AI Regulatory War and Federal Preemption
item.description: This episode explores the intensifying conflict between state and federal AI regulation in the United States, examining the push for federal preemption and its implications for the broader AI governance landscape.
